body.title: Wire the normal MCP and daemon design-review interface
body.summary: Add proposed design-review MCP schema/adapter, daemon RPC and step handler; update normal MCP registration/schema/guide and main-thread/repo authorization routing. Preserve working code review and exact retired-route failures.
acceptanceChecks: Normal insrc_review_step advertises start/progress/assignment/plan/activity/result and routes via short main-owner operations with trusted controller context.
MCP uses generic persistent IPC where needed; native work is independent of observer lifetime and controller ownership lasts across sequential exchanges.
Repo authorization/audit and worker/session routing cannot create a second coordinator; independent subjects can progress without duplicate same-subject execution.
Retired workflow.review, workflow.reviewArtifact, workflow.resolveFinding and old stream/claim/judge helpers remain unavailable; current code-review tool/schema/routes stay intact.
Steering tells controller to poll, expose progress and wait for full review before corrections; no backward-compatibility flag or activation switch.

tests.name: Normal stdio MCP/Unix IPC start and progress reach one main owner; second observer cannot acquire reviewer authority or duplicate execution.
Schema discovery and steering expose current phases, bounded polling and wait-for-completion guidance.
Retired review/stream/resolve routes remain unavailable and current code-review registration/routing stays intact.
